MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of marine and freshwater environments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and climatic conditions in marine and Freshwater and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
